about: Everything the old relay and our Mac-side tools put on the game machine, and what the new package does with each. action: takeover = the new package owns it from switch-over (re-creates or migrates it); remove = the uninstaller deletes it; keep = not ours to remove, or still used by something outside the relay; restore = put back the value saved at switch-over. verify: true = only the machine can tell whether it is still there (not checked from the repo). Sources are code lines or commits on origin/main as of 2026-10-11 (BOARD/打包-遗留清单-1011.md has the same list in Chinese).
